panel_1734178809.name: AppealPanels

guidetextdraw_1578101333._value: Our records indicate that your 2021-2022 financial aid eligibility was based on your approved Dependency Override appeal. Independent status must be examined each academic year. If your situation requires special handling because of your continued claim of independent status, you must complete this Dependency Override Renewal in order for our office to determine your dependency status for 2021-2022. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy.This will delay processing. Review each of the following three statuses and check the one box that best describes your situation:
guidetextdraw_1578101333.name: InstructionText

guidetextdraw_64873203._value: Meet ONE or more of the criteria needed to be considered independent for financial aid purposes:
guidetextdraw_64873203.name: textdraw_648732031665054936622

guidetextdraw_1746977920._value: 1)I was born before January 1, 1997, 2) I will be working on a graduate degree Fall 2021*, 3) I am married, 4) I have children who receive more than half of their support from me, 5) I have other dependents (not my children) who live with me and I provide more than half of their support, 6) both of my parents are deceased; 7) I was a ward of the court, 8) I am a veteran ofthe U.S. Armed Forces, or 9) I was an unaccompanied youth who was homeless.
guidetextdraw_1746977920.name: textdraw_17469779201652083078755

guidetextdraw_1733964040._value: • ACTION:  You are no longer required to submit a Dependency Override renewal to the Office of Financial Aid because you now meet the federal criteria for independent status. Complete the 2020-2021 FAFSA on-line at www.fafsa.ed.gov nolaterthan March 2, 2021 for priority consideration.
guidetextdraw_1733964040.name: textdraw_17339640401654161155969

guidetextdraw_481012805._value: I have reestablished a relationship with my parent(s); therefore I am a dependent student for purposes of applying for financial aid in 2021-2022. My parent(s) will complete the parents’ portion of the FAFSA application.
guidetextdraw_481012805.name: textdraw_4810128051654158087547

guidetextdraw_174697._value: • ACTION: Complete the 2021-2022 FAFSA on-line at www.fafsa.ed.gov including your and your parents’ information nolater than March 2, 2021 for priority consideration.
guidetextdraw_174697.name: textdraw_17469779201652083078755_copy_1

guidetextdraw_1937330506._value: I understand that a Dependency Override is granted on a yearly basis, and that I must reaffirm the unusual and extenuating circumstances that remain unchanged, which led to my approved Dependency Override during 2021-2022.
guidetextdraw_1937330506.name: textdraw_19373305061654158509717

guidetextdraw_278274006._value: Provide an update on your circumstances by using the second page of this form, this will serve as your signed statement. You may type and attach a separate statement addressing each item on page two.
guidetextdraw_278274006.name: textdraw_2782740061654160521541

guidetextdraw_1013612848._value: Complete the 2021-2022 FAFSA on-line at www.fafsa.ed.gov by the priority filing deadline of March 2, 2021. Besure to answer all questions in the student sections ONLY and select the option, “I have a special circumstance and I am unable to provide parental information.” Our office will receive your 2021-2022 FAFSA information from the Central Processing System (CPS) beginning April 2021 and update your independent status accordingly if we approve your appeal.
guidetextdraw_1013612848.name: textdraw_10136128481654158725755

guidetextdraw_1920260805._value: *If you do not attend college Fall 2021, but plan to start your Master’s program Spring 2022, you are considered independent for financial aid purpose
guidetextdraw_1920260805.name: textdraw_19202608051654174270775
